title: Public interface
body: The installed header: the identifier size, the ahead-of-clock bound, the RNG callback type and the five functions.
rationale: One header, binary only: the smallest surface that serves every consumer.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).

title: Generator
body: uuid7_gen(): fetches the random tail, reserves the next (ms, seq) pair by compare-and-swap under the abuse bounds, encodes the 16 bytes.
rationale: Entropy before reservation (no wasted sequence), lock-free reservation, encoding after the reservation is owned.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).

title: Reservation state
body: The single atomic 64-bit word (ms << 12 | seq) and its pack, unpack and raise-only helpers.
rationale: One word makes uniqueness and global order a single compare-and-swap.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).
notes: group=uuid7_cmp_state; type=non-executable (data) and inline helpers; development=new

title: Floor import
body: uuid7_init() and uuid7_raise_floor(): validate a persisted identifier and raise the state to it, never lower.
rationale: Restart continuity without trusting the wall clock; refuse what this format cannot have produced or what is dated beyond the bound.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).

title: Entropy
body: The atomically stored RNG callback, its lazy default, uuid7_set_rng_func() and the built-in getrandom(2) / /dev/urandom source.
rationale: Replaceable entropy; the default is the kernel CSPRNG.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).

title: Clock
body: CLOCK_REALTIME in milliseconds, the clock-failure count and its accessor.
rationale: A failed clock is counted and survived, never silent.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).

title: Test seams
body: The deterministic clock, the forced built-in RNG failure and the state reset, compiled only with -DUUID7_TESTING.
rationale: Determinism for the suites; absent from every shipped artifact.
criteria: The SDD component description matches the code (design inspection).
notes: group=uuid7_cmp_hooks; type=executable (functions), test builds only; development=new
